title: Frequency Estimation Based on SNR-adaptive Frequency Estimator Under Wide SNR Range
abstract: arXiv:2609.07034v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frequency estimation is the problem of estimating individual tone frequencies from noisy multi-tone sinusoidal signals. Existing frequency estimation methods have difficulty accurately estimating both the number of tone frequencies and the individual tone frequencies in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) environments, because weak tone frequency components are buried in noise. In addition, existing methods generally exhibit a trade-off between robustness at low SNR and frequency estimation precision at high SNR, making it difficult to achieve consistently superior frequency estimation performance over a wide SNR range. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes an SNR-adaptive frequency estimator (SAFE). translated_title: 基于信噪比自适应频率估计器的宽信噪比范围频率估计
translated_abstract: 频率估计是从含噪多音正弦信号中估计各个音调频率的问题。现有的频率估计方法在低信噪比（SNR）环境中难以准确估计音调频率的数量和各个音调频率，因为微弱的音调频率成分被淹没在噪声中。此外，现有方法通常在低信噪比下的鲁棒性与高信噪比下的频率估计精度之间存在权衡，使得难以在宽信噪比范围内实现始终优异的频率估计性能。为了克服这些限制，本文提出了一种信噪比自适应频率估计器（SAFE）。SAFE由时频图像神经网络（TFINet）和基于信噪比的频率选择器（SFS）组成，前者用于在低信噪比下增强微弱的音调频率成分，后者根据信噪比选择合适的频率估计器。
tldr: 本文提出信噪比自适应频率估计器SAFE，利用时频图像神经网络增强低信噪比下的微弱频率成分，并通过基于信噪比的频率选择器选择合适的估计器，从而在宽信噪比范围内实现一致优异的频率估计性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an SNR-adaptive frequency estimator (SAFE) that combines a time-frequency image neural network (TFINet) to enhance weak tone components at low SNR with an SNR-based frequency selector (SFS), achieving consistently superior frequency estimation performance over a wide SNR range.
